text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hi, everyone! It's Forever Young, aka
Yanko-chan♪
――Haaah, so many of you are watching!
Thank you, everyone♡

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh. Look like I'm not nervous at all,
don't I? ...'Cause I'm not.
I was sorting out my subscriptions until a
minute ago, haha!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
So relax and hear me out, okay? Have a cup
of tea while you listen!
—All good? Alright, let's get down to
business.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I mean, so much happened before I got to
this point, right?
Winning, losing... this and that, all
so~rts of things.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, February 24th is a
suuuper special milestone.
First and foremost, it's my birthday!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanna celebrate! With synergy
from both of us, let's make it super
lively!
So, I've prepared a "Special Movie" for
today♡

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
A movie capturing the upcoming excitement
of our 'special yet ordinary days.'
Now, everyone, please direct your
attention to the monitors~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Yay, "We finally all got to meet"~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"............ W-Wait just a second, okay!?
Is this really what 'a special yet
ordinary daily life' is supposed to be
like...!?"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Don't stop! Don't stop till the finish! ♪
Ahaha! Sorry, my explanation was totally
sloppy, shoved the camera in your face out
of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"It fits the concept, so singing is fine,
or staying quiet is totally okay too.
The point is to capture Spe just being her
normal self—like, what are you making
there?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is... ehehe.
The feast for the party!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Red... no, white――is it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Since the flowers are greenish, white
should make them stand out nicely,
wouldn't it?
What should we do about the candles, Kris
S-san?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, looks like they're preparing for a
party here, too~.
Wait, why a party anyway? Is there
something awesome to celebrate!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Why, you ask?
Because today calls for a very special
celebration!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Destiny whispered to me this morning!
"Celebrate today!"
"With this crew, do it now! Do it right
away! Do it quick!" it said!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ho, an interesting one enters the
ring!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Happy almost birthday to you――
I received a request for assistance early
this morning. ...Every once in a while,
it's not bad.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... that took me by surprise. Oh,
right. Epiphaneia,
would you mind helping me plate the fruit
if you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll turn it into a
masterpiece
with my genius color coordination! Where
is it!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Wait――Hold on. Did you wash your hands?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It's so lively here~.
Um, the food is ready, would it be alright
if I bring it out?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course! I'll carry stuff too!
We'll carry it, line it up, and toast!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who's on fruit—
............I'll do it myself, then.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"『Burn it into your mind, the flash of
maximum speed
Even at a disadvantage, even if no one
expects a thing
A story of hanging in there and achieving
it all』♪"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
My... Her singing voice has grown even
more powerful, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And right now... It's time for the
suuuurprise caaake!!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?!
W-Why—I mean, when did that happen?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Cake makes things fun, doesn't it?! Then
getting one is nothing at all.
Nothing is impossible—that is the
Epiphaneia way!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... A-Amazing...! E-Er, well, let's
start cutting it for now!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
The party was a blast. Eating giant cake,
laughing our heads off.
And then, Epi suddenly stood up, and
like...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I can hear the Voice of Destiny—! ...Heh,
I see!
Everyone, let's head outside! There's
something I want to show you!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
—Call me again if you need a hand. ...It's
fine, I'd hate to turn you down anyway.
Besides, I'm glad to see our signs going
up in more places. See you later, Dad.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Oh, everyone's here. Good
evening~.
Are you heading out to do some stargazing?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Logo! I knew you'd come!
Which means you're watching it with us!
Here—it's coming, the shooting star!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? A shooting star...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Look!!!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"............ Wow.
...As expected, you really are amazing,
Epi-san."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right, right?! Exactly, I'm
amazing!
...Rogo, did you make a wish?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"'A wish'... Hmm.
Maybe... 'I hope I can shine brightly too,
so I won't lose to anyone.'"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Heh, shining bright enough not to be
outdone by the stars, huh. Nice!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
No, no, well—
...Well, I guess they're pretty much the
same thing.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... In that case, for my part—
May the Umamusume running in the future
shine bright and bloom into magnificent
flowers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――I agree. ...I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What did Yan-ko 'wish' for?
Heheh, well, let's see. ............It's a
secret!
